references.text: The Lord gives water from the rock at Horeb after instructing Moses, showing God's care for His people by providing them with water in the wilderness.
The Lord commands Moses to speak to the rock to give the people water, a parallel event where God promises to supply Israel with water.
The song of the well that Israel sings, directly linked to the well (Be'er) which the Lord gave them in verse 16.
At Elim, Israel found twelve springs of water, showing God's continued care for the people's need for water during their journey through the wilderness.
The prophecy about drawing water with joy from the wells of salvation, pointing back to God's gift of water to His people.
Jesus speaks of living water that He gives, a spiritual fulfillment of God's promise to give His people water.
Jesus invites those who are thirsty to come and drink, promising streams of living water, connecting to God's miracle of water in the wilderness.
